  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `python3 -I` implies `-E`, so the explicit `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` on the builder call and the digest-count call is ignored. `_load_wrapper_renderer()` then writes `.pyc` files into the upstream support checkout.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: three reviewers rated it NIT and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR, so the highest is used (MAJOR, mapped to high). minimax_minimax-m3 adds that a read-only checkout makes the `.pyc` write fail, which sets `manifest_failed` and fails open. The fix is `python3 -I -B` on both calls.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh:1872-1875, 1880 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The python3 invocations lack `-B`, and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` is ignored under `-I`. `exec_module` on `workflow_wrapper_refs.py` writes `.pyc` files into the upstream support checkout.
  WHY: On a read-only support checkout the write raises `OSError`, which `_load_wrapper_renderer()` turns into a `ManifestError`. That sets `skip_reason="manifest_failed"` and the resolver fails open. The suggested fix is `-I -B` on both calls, dropping the redundant env token, and tightening the test regex.
